text.tspan: 1 · Customer journey: from first visit to delivered order, with a change in the order
Ekte Mat ordering system (to-be). Source: docs/requirements/basic_desc.txt. Payment is not integrated: the customer picks a payment option on the order.

Event-type minimum guests (example values; admin can set 1–265): corporate lunch 8 · birthday 10 · confirmation 15 · christmas party 20 · conference 30 · wedding 50. The minimum in force when the order is placed is saved on the order.
